messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-12345) — node gpu-node-74 reported KERNEL_PANIC and kubelet Unhealthy. Page level: P1. Link: https://pd.example/PD-12345

pagerduty-bot: Alert details: service=redwood-serving/gpu-pool-1, check=kubelet-health, symptom=kubelet not ready, host=gpu-node-74, region=us-west-2

samir: ack — I’m taking the pager. Oncall now. Starting triage.

alex: thx samir. are pods being rescheduled? any customer-facing impact?

samir: quick check — model-serving pods on that node are in CrashLoopBackOff. k8s rescheduler started evictions but some replicas still pending. latency spike on endpoint /v1/chat for a subset of requests. looking at metrics.

maya: support note: a couple customers seeing 504s in last 30s — not widespread yet. opened internal ticket CS-709.

samir: cordoning node now to stop new schedules:
```bash
kubectl cordon gpu-node-74
kubectl drain gpu-node-74 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=30
```

samir: drain in progress. some pods are stuck terminating (gpu-driver-daemonset?). forcing evict for model-serving replicas.

samir: grabbing kernel logs from the host via serial console. attaching tail of dmesg: 
```
[  345.120345] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
[  345.120350] pcieport 0000:65:00.0: AER: Uncorrected (Non-Fatal) error received:
[  346.450120] kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[  347.000012] reboot: forcing reboot
```

samir: looks like a GPU PCIe fault leading to kernel panic. NVMe SMART also shows some media errors but not sure if related. pinging hardware-oncall. @hardware-oncall can you ops escalate for rack-level hardware checks?

hardware-oncall: acknowledged. standing up a hardware ticket. asking to keep node cordoned and do not reboot from k8s until we attach serial and run memtest.

samir: re: customer impact — routing policy kicked in: requests are being routed to fallback pool (gpu-pool-2) but warmup latency is visible. spike for multi-token generation (200-500ms extra). telemetry: 12 tenants had increased 5xx in last 2 mins, ~0.5% overall TPS affected.

alex: can we increase autoscale on gpu-pool-2 to soak traffic?

samir: scaling now — increasing replicas for model-deployments that had pending replicas:
```bash
kubectl -n prod scale deploy model-inference --replicas=40 --selector=pool=gpu-pool-2
```

samir: also enabling temporary reduced-batch config to lower p99 CPU on fallback nodes. applying rollout.

pagerduty-bot: PD-12345 acked by samir at 2175004335. Escalation policy progressing: oncall->shift-lead->eng-sre.

zoe: looping in for continuity. I'm available to take over if this crosses my shift window. summarize current state?

samir: summary for handoff:
- root cause: suspected GPU PCIe error -> kernel panic on gpu-node-74, host rebooted automatically.
- current actions: node cordoned/drained; fallback routing to gpu-pool-2; increased replicas and reduced batch settings; hardware ticket opened; serial console attached; not rebooting from k8s.
- customer impact: transient 5xx/latency increase (~0.5% TPS), CS ticket created for impacted accounts.
- next steps: hardware team to run memtest & NVMe diagnostics, collect full journalctl -k + dmesg logs, consider permanent cordon + reprovision if HW fails. monitor autoscale and cost.

zoe: got it. I'll pick this up in 20m if still active. ping me for handover then.

maya: notifying Support escalation: CS-709 updated with PD link and customer list. drafting outbound template if customers ask for ETA.

samir: attaching full journal tail for completeness:
```
-- Journal begins at Fri 2025-11-12 03:12:00 UTC --
Nov 12 03:45:20 gpu-node-74 kernel: nvme0: I/O 0 QID 0 timeout, aborting command
Nov 12 03:45:21 gpu-node-74 NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00: GPU has fallen off the bus
Nov 12 03:45:21 gpu-node-74 kernel: unexpected signal during IRQ handling
Nov 12 03:45:22 gpu-node-74 kernel: kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
Nov 12 03:45:27 gpu-node-74 systemd[1]: Rebooting.
```

samir: will also collect SMART from NVMe and run `nvme-cli` diagnostics. if HW team confirms PCIe riser or GPU failure we'll reprovision.

hardware-oncall: HW ticket updated: HT-842. ordering replacement GPU on standby. ETA for on-site tech 45-90m. recommending isolate node and reprovision from spare image.

samir: re: on-call escalation — do we want to trigger an incident with incident commander? right now impact limited but P1 due to host kernel panic and customer facing errors.

alex: recommend keeping P1 until hardware confirms reprovision or we see mitigation complete. assign comms owner? maya can own external comms.

maya: happy to own comms. will coordinate with CS and send one status update in 15m.

zoe: handoff note: if hardware confirms permanent failure, plan: 1) cordon permanently 2) replace node 3) rebuild image with kernel+driver patch if reproducible 4) run soak tests before rejoining pool. I’ll trigger the rebuild playbook (infra/playbooks/reprovision-node).

samir: agree. leaving a temp comment in k8s: `kubectl annotate node gpu-node-74 redwood/incident=PD-12345` so autoscaling won't attempt to re-add until manual.

samir: final check — after scaling, 5xx rate back to baseline for most tenants, a few still hitting retries. monitoring + dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/ingress/PD-12345

pagerduty-bot: PD-12345 status: acked -> investigation. Next escalation in 30m if unresolved.

zoe: taking over active monitoring for next 1h. samir — drop any last notes here before stepping out.

samir: nothing else immediate. left commands run + logs in HT-842 and CS-709. if we see repeat kernel panics across multiple hosts, open a critical incident and pull in firmware/driver teams.

maya: posted external status to impacted customers (templated): 
> We experienced transient errors on some model endpoints due to a host kernel panic. Our mitigation routed traffic to alternate capacity; our engineering and hardware teams are investigating. We'll update within 30 minutes.

zoe: thanks all. I’ll update this thread with HW ticket outcomes and final resolution. :thumbsup:
